system: You are a code completion engine. The user message is a source file that ends at the cursor. Continue the file exactly at the cursor, starting with the very next character. Output only the raw continuation. No markdown, no code fences, no explanation, no repetition of existing code.

expense.summary: Der Code berechnet die Erstattung von Spesenabrechnungen. Jeder Beleg wird nach seiner Kategorie (Verpflegung, Übernachtung, Kilometergeld, Bewirtung) mit Obergrenzen und Prozentsätzen bewertet, verfallene Belege zählen nicht, und der Vorschuss wird von der Summe abgezogen. Daneben bildet er den Freigabeprozess vom Entwurf über die Einreichung bis zur Genehmigung oder Ablehnung ab, mit Vier-Augen-Prinzip und Unterschriftsgrenzen.

lines: * An amount of money in whole cents. Integer arithmetic keeps sums exact;

* Hotel stays: breakfast is not reimbursable, so its flat price per night is

* The first 200 km get the full rate, every further kilometre 60 % of it.

// Receipts older than 90 days are refunded with nothing; otherwise the category rule decides.
* Lifecycle of a claim: Draft, then Submitted, then either Approved or Rejected.
* Approved and Rejected are final. Days are plain day numbers.
// A submitted claim should be decided within 14 days; after that it is overdue.
// An approved claim is paid 30 days after the decision.
// Signing authority: a team lead approves totals up to and including the limit, a director any amount.
// The advance is offset against the refund; an advance larger than the refund yields zero, not a debt.
* State transitions of a claim. A transition that is not allowed in the
* current state returns the status unchanged instead of failing.
// Only a draft with a positive refund can be submitted.
* Four-eyes principle: nobody approves their own claim. The authority limit
* is checked against the reimbursable total, before the advance is deducted.
// Money is paid only for approved claims, and then only the payout after the advance.

parking.summary: Der Code berechnet Parkgebühren und verwaltet die Belegung von Parkplätzen. Er modelliert Aufenthalte in Minuten, Tag- und Nachttarife, Parkplatzarten wie Ladeplatz oder Behindertenparkplatz sowie Dauerparkkarten mit Freiminuten. Zentral ist die Gebühr: angefangene Stunden zum Stundensatz mit Tageshöchstbetrag, danach Zuschlag oder Rabatt je nach Parkplatz.

lines: * A money amount in cents. Integer arithmetic only, so rounding is

* than the daily cap, so a long stay is never dearer than full days.
// Night tariff: a flat rate for every started 12-hour night (720 minutes), no grace period.

payroll.summary: Der Code berechnet die monatliche Lohnabrechnung von Mitarbeitern in Cent. Er modelliert Vertragsarten (Gehalt, Stundenlohn mit Überstundenzuschlag, Minijob), Beschäftigungsstatus (aktiv, beurlaubt, ausgeschieden), Steuerklassen mit Freibeträgen und weitere Abzüge. Zentral ist die Lohnabrechnung: Brutto nach Status, minus progressiver Steuer und Abzüge ergibt das Netto; dazu kommen Abschlagszahlungen und Statuswechsel.

lines: * An amount of money in euro cents. All arithmetic is integer arithmetic,
* so percentages and pro-rata shares are truncated toward zero.
// rate is a whole percentage, e.g. 125 means 125 %.
* Where an employee stands in the employment lifecycle, and how much of the
* contractual gross pay is actually payable this month because of it.
// Active: full gross. OnLeave: the agreed percentage. Terminated: pro rata up to and including the last working day.
/** The kind of employment contract, which determines the monthly gross pay before status adjustments. */
* Paid per hour worked in the month. Hours beyond the regular 160 per month
* count as overtime and are paid at 125 % of the hourly wage.
/** Marginal employment: the agreed pay is capped at the monthly earnings limit of 556.00 euros. */
* Simplified two-band income tax on monthly amounts: the first 3,000.00 euros
* of taxable income are taxed at 20 %, everything above at 35 %.
// A tax-free allowance larger than the gross yields zero tax, never a negative one.
/** The tax class decides which tax-free allowance applies before the progressive table. */
// Single parents get an extra allowance of 350.00 euros per child on top of the basic allowance.
* Income splitting: the gross is split evenly between both spouses, each half
* is taxed with its own basic allowance, and the tax is doubled. This keeps a
* high single income out of the upper band longer.
/** A further deduction from pay after income tax; it may be based on the gross or on the tax. */
// Social insurance: a percentage of the gross, but only up to the contribution ceiling.
// Church tax is a percentage of the income tax, not of the gross.
// A fixed pension contribution, never more than the gross actually paid.
/** The result of one payroll calculation: net = gross - tax - deducted. */
/** One monthly payroll run; daysInMonth is needed to pro-rate pay for terminated employees. */
// Contractual gross, then adjusted by the employment status (leave, termination).
// Mid-month advance of half the gross: taxed on its own, other deductions are not applied.
* Status transitions of the HR lifecycle. Each transition only applies from a
* valid state; otherwise the status is returned unchanged, so a terminated
* employee can neither go on leave nor be terminated again.

rental.summary: Der Code berechnet Rechnungen für eine Autovermietung und verwaltet den Ablauf einer Miete von der Reservierung über die Übergabe bis zur Rückgabe oder Stornierung. Er modelliert Fahrzeugklassen, Versicherungsarten, Mietzeitraum, Kilometerstand und Fahrer. Zentral ist die Rechnung aus Miete mit Wochenrabatt und Saisonfaktor, Mehrkilometern und Versicherungsprämie.

ticketing.summary: Der Code berechnet Ticketpreise für eine Veranstaltung und verwaltet den Verkaufsstatus. Er modelliert Platzkategorien (Stehplatz, Sitzreihe, Lounge), dynamische Preisregeln (Frühbucherrabatt, Aufschlag bei hoher Auslastung), Promo-Codes und ein Sitzplatzkontingent. Zentral ist der Bestellpreis aus Kategoriepreis, Preisregel, Platzanzahl und gedeckelter Servicegebühr sowie der Statuswechsel von angekündigt über im Verkauf bis ausverkauft oder abgesagt.

warehouse.summary: Der Code modelliert den Bestand eines Lagers: Artikel mit Packungsgröße, Bestand mit reservierten Stücken und einen Status (ausreichend, knapp, gesperrt). Zentral sind die Berechnung der Kommissionierzeit je nach Handhabung (normal, gekühlt, Gefahrgut) und der Nachbestellvorschlag in ganzen Packungen. Bei knappem Bestand werden nur ganze Packungen kommissioniert, gesperrte Ware gar nicht.

lines: * A quantity of an article counted in single pieces.

// Rounds down to complete packs; leftover loose pieces are dropped.

* Only the unreserved remainder is available for new demand.
// Shipping fulfils a reservation: the goods leave the shelf and the promise is released.

// Hazardous goods may only be carried in limited amounts, so each started trip adds 45 seconds.

* A full pack takes a fixed time to pick, loose pieces take a time per piece.
// Pick time in seconds: full packs plus loose remainder, then adjusted for handling.
/** Decides when stock is too low and how many pieces to reorder, always in whole packs. */

* Keeps enough stock to cover daily demand during the supplier lead time plus safety days.
* When below that minimum, it orders up to the minimum plus one week of demand,
* so the article does not need to be reordered again before the next weekly review.
// Reorder suggestions are based on available stock, so reserved pieces count as already gone.
/** Status transitions for an article's stock. */
// Quarantine is sticky: a stock check never lifts it, only an explicit release does.

* Never picks more than is available. When stock is low, only whole packs are picked,
